prompt_en: A photographic swimwear editorial featuring one adult woman, age 28, using the attached portrait as the facial-appearance reference: preserve her recognizable facial proportions, brown eyes, and long dark wavy hair. She wears a deep jade green two-piece bikini with separate triangular cups gathered along a thin underbust string, paired halter strings visibly rising from the cup tips and tying behind the neck, and a matching low-rise bottom with two narrow strings tied into a bow at each hip. The exposed gap between top and bottom clearly establishes two separate garments. Opaque finely ribbed swim fabric and bound cup edges remain legible against wet skin. At a glass-roofed botanical plunge pool, she stands on the first broad submerged step in ankle-deep water, turning her face toward camera while her raised right hand catches a falling stream from a copper rain spout. Water breaks against her open palm and scatters into distinct droplets; the left hand rests on the tiled coping behind her hip, leaving both side bows visible. Late-afternoon sun breaking through rain makes the drops sparkle and projects the window mullions across the wet terracotta deck. Tall broad leaves behind glass, rain beads on the panes, and overlapping rings around her ankles establish a humid sheltered pool during a passing shower. Use an eye-level, full-body vertical composition, with the face, cup construction, neck strings, hip bows, hand-stream contact, and feet readable together. A restrained editorial color grade preserves natural skin texture, the fabric ribs, and the contrast between cool water and warm terracotta. Her expression is quietly amused by the cold stream. The garment silhouette makes clear that the swim top and swim bottom are separate garments; the top hem remains distinct from the bottom waistband. Place her slightly right of center so the spout and raised hand form a diagonal across the upper left. A narrow reflected pool-light fill keeps the face and dark jade fabric readable under the brighter window beam.
